issues.failure_explanation: Lemma lem:B_op_norm_bound only guarantees an equivalent vector norm in which the operator norm of A_s is <1. The W_2 metric on P_2(V_s) is induced by the Euclidean norm, so the W_2-Lipschitz constant of A_s is its Euclidean operator norm, which need not be <1.
